relation_statement: Each scaling factor (loss scale, gradient-accumulation scale) must be applied to the loss exactly once before backward.
observable_signal: gradient magnitude off by the gradient-accumulation factor relative to a singly-scaled baseline
validity_precondition: loss scaling enabled together with gradient-accumulation loss scaling in engine backward
evidence_from_issue: Loss double-scaling in backward — scale_if_loss applied to gas_scaled_loss
evidence_from_fix: root_cause field empty in record; inferred from title

relation_statement: The cached secondary parameter partition must be invalidated or refreshed whenever the primary partition changes (weight load, checkpoint resume), before it feeds any allgather.
observable_signal: checksum mismatch between the allgathered full parameter and the master partition contents after a load event
validity_precondition: ZeRO-3 with hierarchical ZeRO++ secondary partitions, after GatheredParameters weight update or load_checkpoint
evidence_from_issue: ds_secondary_tensor stale after model load / checkpoint resume — dirty allgather poisons next forward
evidence_from_fix: secondary tensor was never refreshed after the master ds_tensor changed; next allgather constructs a corrupted parameter mixing new master weights with old secondary values

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation dtype of the fused loss kernel must match the fp32 accumulation precision of the unfused baseline under guard that mixed-precision training uses the fused linear+CE implementation.
observable_signal: dtype of the fused kernel's gradient accumulation buffer; divergence of loss curves vs the unfused baseline
validity_precondition: LM head uses fused linear cross-entropy implementation under bf16 mixed precision
evidence_from_issue: fused_linear_cross_entropy_loss accumulates gradient in bf16 by default — silently noisier than fp32 accumulation
evidence_from_fix: the fused call defaulted accum_grad to bf16, which silently degraded gradient precision on the LM head and shifted loss curves vs the unfused baseline

relation_statement: Every model-held parameter must carry the configured target floating-point dtype after the init-time cast, while remaining the same Parameter object the model references, under a sharded-init context.
observable_signal: param.dtype of each registered nn.Parameter compared against the configured target dtype at end of init
validity_precondition: parameters constructed inside a sharded-init (zero.Init) context, including tensors created with requires_grad=True
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO param dtype cast reassigns Parameter to a non-Parameter Tensor
evidence_from_fix: .to() returns a fresh non-Parameter Tensor; the model still held the original reference, so the model's Parameter kept the wrong dtype

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation buffer dtype must equal the model dtype whenever sharded-gradient reduction assumes matching dtypes.
observable_signal: dtype of the allocated grad-accumulation buffers vs model parameter dtype at engine init
validity_precondition: bf16 model with sharded optimizer (ZeRO) enabled and no explicit grad_accum_dtype configured
evidence_from_issue: BF16 model + ZeRO defaults silently force fp32 grad accum buffer despite ZeRO requiring matching dtype
evidence_from_fix: auto-selected fp32 for bf16 models; accumulation buffers in fp32 while reduction ran in bf16, so accumulated gradients were lost on the first cast back

relation_statement: The muP attention scale must equal sqrt(base_d)/d, matching the standard-parameterization scale 1/sqrt(d) exactly at the base width, whenever use_mup is enabled on the SDP path.
observable_signal: The numeric attention scale factor applied in SDP vs the prescribed sqrt(mup_base_n_heads)/head_dim; a 1/d scale at base width witnesses the mismatch.
validity_precondition: model.use_mup=true on the scaled-dot-product attention path (not flash varlen)
evidence_from_issue: muP attention scale uses 1/d instead of sqrt(base_d)/d, mismatching the SP scale at the base width
evidence_from_fix: the scale differs from 1/sqrt(d) even at the base width, silently changing attention temperature; fix uses sqrt(mup_base_n_heads)/q.size(-1) so the scale matches SP at base width

relation_statement: The learning rate at each training progress point must follow the configured sqrt-decay functional form 1-sqrt(1-progress) under guard that the sqrt decay scheduler is selected.
observable_signal: logged learning-rate time series compared against the closed-form schedule value at each step
validity_precondition: sqrt decay LR scheduler active, during the decay phase of training
evidence_from_issue: sqrt decay LR schedule uses wrong formula — decay curve inverted
evidence_from_fix: sqrt(progress) instead of 1-sqrt(1-progress) — wrong decay curve shape

relation_statement: Replicated router/gate weights must be identical across DP ranks after module construction, even when perform_initialization=False.
observable_signal: cross-DP-rank checksum of the router weight after module creation
validity_precondition: MoE router or shared-expert gate creation with config.perform_initialization=False (weights expected to be loaded from checkpoint)
evidence_from_issue: MoE router weight initialized with DP RNG fork even when perform_initialization=False
evidence_from_fix: the else branch also unconditionally re-initialized the weight on CPU outside any RNG fork, silently re-randomizing router weights with different values across DP ranks

relation_statement: Persistent buffers such as the router expert bias must retain their pre-warmup values after CUDA graph capture warmup.
observable_signal: checksum of the router expert_bias buffer before vs after graph warmup/capture
validity_precondition: MoE router with aux-loss-free routing (expert_bias) when CUDA graph warmup runs the router forward
evidence_from_issue: CUDA-graph warmup overwrites MoE router expert_bias persistent buffer
evidence_from_fix: _CudaGraphRunner saved/restored parameter grads but not persistent buffers; warmup forward passes mutated expert_bias, and post-capture state diverged from pre-capture state

relation_statement: The truncated-normal init distribution's cutoff must equal the user-supplied init_cutoff_factor under guard: Mitchell init path.
observable_signal: Truncation width (max|w|/std) of the sampled init weights vs configured cutoff_factor.
validity_precondition: init_fn=mitchell for OLMoBlock/OLMoSequentialBlock/OLMoLlamaBlock and wte init
evidence_from_issue: Mitchell init hardcodes cutoff_factor=3.0, ignoring user-supplied init_cutoff_factor
evidence_from_fix: every code path literally assigned cutoff_factor = 3.0, ignoring config.init_cutoff_factor, producing narrower truncated-normal weights

relation_statement: All-reduced parameter/gradient sums and norms must be divided by the number of model replicas before use, so logged optimizer metrics equal the true per-replica values under HSDP.
observable_signal: Logged per-param avg and grad_norm metrics vs values computed within a single replica: inflation by the replica count N witnesses the missing division.
validity_precondition: HSDP with num_model_replicas > 1, collect_param_metrics=True, param-norm metrics logged
evidence_from_issue: Reduced sums/norms not divided by num_model_replicas in HSDP, optimizer metrics inflated by replica count
evidence_from_fix: after dist.all_reduce(SUM), identical replica contributions are summed N times; fix divides the all-reduced tensors by self.num_model_replicas before splitting and using

relation_statement: The sequence-parallel all-to-all reshape must preserve the (batch, sequence, head) identity of every token, so post-scatter activations correspond to the same logical tokens.
observable_signal: round-trip all_to_all followed by inverse all_to_all not reproducing the input layout; query[b,s,h] mapped to a different logical token than key/value
validity_precondition: distributed-attention sequence parallelism using the head-scatter (scatter_idx >= 2) all-to-all path
evidence_from_issue: single_all_to_all reshape collapses batch and seq dims — QKV permuted into wrong tokens
evidence_from_fix: reshape collapses batch and sequence and reorders elements such that query[b,s,h] no longer corresponds to the same logical token; attention computed on scrambled tokens

relation_statement: The set of gradients gathered for the global norm must match the set of trainable parameters with gradients (no parameter silently contributing nothing) under FP8 + precision-aware optimizer settings.
observable_signal: Reported grad_norm value: exactly 0.0 while the loss is changing (empty grads_for_norm set) witnesses the violation; also count of tensors contributing to the norm vs trainable-parameter count.
validity_precondition: use_precision_aware_optimizer enabled with FP8 non-delayed/DS scaling, gradient clipping or count_zeros active
evidence_from_issue: FP8 + precision-aware paths read param.decoupled_grad which is None and report grad_norm=0
evidence_from_fix: the buggy gate took the precision-aware path anyway, attempting to read param.decoupled_grad (None), so grads_for_norm came back empty and grad_norm computed to 0.0; without proper clipping the optimizer could overshoot

relation_statement: The loader's token_dtype must match the on-disk token dtype (uint32 for vocab>65535) under guard: no explicit token_dtype given.
observable_signal: Token IDs in-range vs corrupted; loader dtype vs file dtype.
validity_precondition: tokenizer vocab_size>65535, PerFileChunkedInstanceSourceConfig without explicit token_dtype
evidence_from_issue: defaults token_dtype to uint16 — silent token-id corruption for vocab > 65535
evidence_from_fix: default uint16 reinterprets uint32 file bytes as separate tokens, producing wrong in-range IDs

relation_statement: The realized token-to-expert dispatch mapping must preserve the router's top-k (token, expert_slot) assignment layout on every EP rank.
observable_signal: dispatched local (token, expert) pairs vs a reference mapping recomputed from the routing indices (masked_select flat ordering)
validity_precondition: MoE base-layer dispatch path with moe_router_topk > 1
evidence_from_issue: MoE local_indices wrong via fancy indexing on bool mask when topk > 1
evidence_from_fix: advanced indexing collapses dimensions breaking the (token, expert_slot) layout, resulting in tokens being routed to the wrong experts on each EP rank

relation_statement: The allgather partition buffer must match each parameter's own dtype when a parameter group mixes floating dtypes under ZeRO-3.
observable_signal: parameter checksum/NaN scan after allgather compared against the rank-local shard contents (garbage bit patterns witness violation)
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with a model containing parameters of more than one floating dtype
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 allgather hardcodes ds_tensor dtype — mixed-dtype param groups silently allgather wrong bytes
evidence_from_fix: one flat partition buffer assumed a single ds_tensor dtype; larger-dtype params were silently truncated/aliased into the smaller-dtype buffer, so parameters held garbage bit patterns after allgather

relation_statement: The total number of constructed dataset instances must be at least training_steps * batch_size (matching the requested per-source token budget) under guard that a source-mixture dataset backs a fixed-step run.
observable_signal: total instance count vs required count; epoch counter incrementing (entering epoch 2) before the configured step budget is exhausted; unexpected loss drop near end of run
validity_precondition: mixture dataset with per-source ratios; training step budget near the dataset boundary
evidence_from_issue: rounded down per-source instances — dataset shorter than expected
evidence_from_fix: integer-floor of tokens_requested_per_path // sequence_length dropped per-path remainders, so total instances < training_steps * batch_size and the trainer silently ran into epoch 2

relation_statement: The byte embedding initialization distribution (mean/std) must match the teacher embedding statistics after the init-fix routine runs under guard that distillation with target embeddings is configured.
observable_signal: mean/std of the byte embedding weights after init compared against the computed teacher-embedding mean/std
validity_precondition: encoder init-fix called with target (teacher) embeddings provided in distillation training
evidence_from_issue: byte embeddings never initialized to teacher-embedding stats — kept default kaiming
evidence_from_fix: te_mean and te_std were used only for hash_embeddings; the main embedding weight was never assigned the te-scaled init, so its distribution did not match the teacher's vocabulary embeddings

relation_statement: Every loss term added to the optimized combined loss must be attached to the autograd graph (contribute nonzero gradient) under guard that the regularizer's multiplier is set.
observable_signal: requires_grad/grad_fn of the z_loss tensor entering combined_loss; zero gradient contribution from the z_loss branch while its metric value is nonzero
validity_precondition: PoE training path active with z_loss_multiplier set and the head emitting z_loss as a detached metric
evidence_from_issue: PoE z_loss combined into combined_loss is detached, contributing value but no gradient
evidence_from_fix: LMHead emits output.z_loss as a detached metric tensor; the optimizer saw the value in metrics while backprop applied zero z_loss gradient, so logit-norm regularization never constrained the weights

relation_statement: Every sub-optimizer's parameters and optimizer state must be restored from the checkpoint after resume, matching the saved values, under a chained optimizer with a single model chunk.
observable_signal: Post-resume checksum of expert parameters / sub-optimizer states vs checkpoint contents; expert parameters equal to fresh default initialization after resume witnesses the skipped load.
validity_precondition: ChainedOptimizer with multiple sub-optimizers (e.g. dense + MoE) and a single global model chunk, loading via split_state_dict
evidence_from_issue: only assigns to state_dicts[0], leaving all other sub-optimizers unaware of the model state and silently skipping their load
evidence_from_fix: state_dicts[1:] left as None ... sub-optimizers beyond index 0 silently skipped loading; the model proceeded with default-initialized expert parameters after a checkpoint resume

relation_statement: The bookkeeping completion callback must finish before the join returns and before any state snapshot is captured under guard that an async bookkeeping op with a completion callback is in flight.
observable_signal: state_dict capture observing pre-callback state (e.g., un-rotated checkpoint indexes) after join has returned
validity_precondition: trainer launches an async bookkeeping op (e.g., async checkpoint save) whose callback mutates state later captured by state_dict()
evidence_from_issue: bookkeeping callback fires after future is FINISHED — state_dict snapshot can capture pre-callback state
evidence_from_fix: add_done_callback runs after the future is marked FINISHED, so _join_bookkeeping_ops returned before cb ran and a state_dict() capture could observe stale callback state

relation_statement: Expert parameter buffers used in forward must equal the optimizer's updated main parameters after parameter synchronization completes, even when the gather group size is 1.
observable_signal: expert parameter checksum vs updated main-parameter values after param sync (stale values from previous step's gather buffer)
validity_precondition: layerwise distributed optimizer with expert data-parallel instance size == 1 and MoE expert parameters present
evidence_from_issue: Layerwise distributed optimizer never marks param_gather as dispatched when expt_dp_size=1
evidence_from_fix: param_gather_dispatched remained False so finish_param_sync never executed; expert params were left at uninitialized/stale values from previous step's gather buffer

relation_statement: The flex-attention backend's output must agree (within tolerance) with the reference SDPA backend on the same inputs under guard that both claim the same attention semantics in bf16 training.
observable_signal: divergence of attention outputs / loss trajectories between the flex and SDPA backends on identical inputs
validity_precondition: flex-attention backend selected with bf16 inputs while the reference path computes in fp32
evidence_from_issue: Flex attention not upcast to fp32 — precision mismatch with SDPA backend
evidence_from_fix: flex attention ran directly on bf16 q/k/v while SDPA runs matmul/softmax in fp32, silently producing lower-precision outputs and different loss trajectories between backends

relation_statement: The effective load-balancing aux loss per global batch must be invariant to the number of micro-batches (divided by num_micro_batches) under guard: gradient accumulation with MoE.
observable_signal: Accumulated aux-loss contribution / router-pressure gradient magnitude vs num_micro_batches.
validity_precondition: block_type=moe, moe_expert_choice=False, num_micro_batches>1
evidence_from_issue: MoE load-balancing loss not divided by num_micro_batches in gradient accumulation loop
evidence_from_fix: full aux loss added per micro-batch without dividing, scaling LB regularizer by N micro-batches

relation_statement: Reduced expert gradients must be averaged with the effective data-parallel world size as divisor, not the smaller expert-DP group size, when ep_size differs from dp_size.
observable_signal: reduced expert-gradient magnitude off by factor dp/edp relative to dense gradients; effective divisor applied in reduction vs dp world size
validity_precondition: MoE layers under ZeRO stage 1/2 with ep_size != dp_size
evidence_from_issue: expert gradients pre-divide by edp_world_size then skip the bucket-level divide — net divisor is dp/edp not dp
evidence_from_fix: the proper averaging factor should be dp_world_size, not edp_world_size; expert gradients are systematically off by a factor of (dp/edp)
